Aniimo can be further developed through <style=Hint_BgL>Capability Awakening</style>, allowing you to consume Star Dust and other items to <style=Hint_BgL>increase</style> the <style=Hint_BgL>Acquired Potential</style> of a selected attribute.
1. An Aniimo’s six core attributes have both [Innate Potential] and [Acquired Potential].
<style=Hint_BgL>[Innate Potential]</style> is determined at birth and can only be increased through special methods such as using Capafruit.
<style=Hint_BgL>[Acquired Potential]</style> can be increased through Capability Awakening. The more times it is increased, the more and rarer items are required.
However, <style=Hint_BgL>the total of Innate Potential and Acquired Potential</style> is capped at <style=Hint_BgL>20</style>. The higher the Potential, the more that attribute grows as the Aniimo levels up.

2. The number of times an Aniimo can undergo Capability Awakening depends on its growth stage and level. Capability Awakening progress cannot be reset, but it can be passed on to another Aniimo of the same family through the inheritance feature.
